s-li.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-li.card_subtitle_as_published: Organic only. Sponsored impressions (Nov 2025–Jun 2026) left out.
s-li.commentary_as_published: October closed above September on more posts (63 page updates against 44 in the connector count); impressions rose 8.4%, so reach per post fell. July and August remain the two biggest months.
s-li.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: LinkedIn Pages via Supermetrics (105562357, organic), pulled Nov 2 2026, full months. Earlier months: LinkedIn page admin analytics (organic).

s-ig.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ig.commentary_as_published: October closed 8.8% below September and well below the spring and summer. The 18 of 45 posts with an accepted collaborator drew a median 959 views, against 293 for the 27 without.
s-ig.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: Instagram Insights via Supermetrics (IGI 17841471383675991), account views, pulled Nov 2 2026, full months. Earlier months: Instagram's own reports.

s-yt.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-yt.commentary_as_published: All organic since September. October closed at 3,461 views, 21.7% below September; YouTube search brought 57% of views.
s-yt.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: YouTube via Supermetrics (YT2), pulled Nov 2 2026, full months; no ADVERTISING traffic since August. Earlier months: YouTube Studio reports.

s-ga.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ga.commentary_as_published: Moment Awards voting more than doubled site sessions: 13,141 in October against 6,218 in September. 96% of the 7,529 sessions that included a /vote page went to no other page; without voting, sessions were between 9.6% down and 1.0% up on September. Episode pages grew 4.8%.
s-ga.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: GA4 489265998 via Supermetrics (America/New_York), pulled Nov 2 2026, full months. Earlier months: GA4 native reports.

s-nl.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-nl.commentary_as_published: The step-ups are imports (5,588 of 5,753 October adds; 3,045 on Oct 26–27, after the last send). Open rate fell to 34.4% as the list grew; verified clicks per delivered email held at 0.53%.

s-syn.section_headline: Reposts with the reposter's own words lifted October engagement by a third
s-syn.card_title: October: organic vs syndicated engagement, the six posts with the most syndicated engagement
s-syn.card_subtitle_as_published: Reactions + comments + reposts. Organic is on ATM's post; syndicated is on reposts that carried the reposter's own words.
s-syn.commentary_as_published: Reposts with the reposter's own words added 718 engagements to 2,130 organic across the 65 October posts: 1.34×, against 1.28× in September. These six posts drew 457 of the 718, mostly from guests and honorees reposting their own cut. A recommendation for the social team: send guests suggested repost copy on publish day.
s-syn.source_platform_and_window: Organic: LinkedIn Pages via Supermetrics, per post. Syndicated: the Reposts list on every October post, read in the LinkedIn page admin view on Nov 2 2026; ATM team members left out.

s-sect.commentary_as_published: Ad tech and brands lead. Publicis and IPG voices are missing, and CPG beyond PepsiCo and Hello Products, and pharma beyond Organon, are thin.
s-sect.source_platform_and_window: October post log, monday.com and Teams live links; sector assigned by hand (Oct 28–31 added Nov 2)
